text:
Nora (Sales): Quick handoff - Helixera signed 12mo Dedicated + private model mount request. PoC passed, exec sponsor onboard. Need CS to run onboarding and compliance items.

Nora (Sales): Account health: high. Procurement asked for PHI controls and KMS/HSM timing. Target go-live ~28 days.

Priya (CS): I will take lead. Owners: Priya (onboarding), Evan (runbooks & tickets), Ritika (support/playbook), Marco (VPC/peering), Devin (smoke tests).

Nora (Sales): Tech asks: Okta SAML+SCIM, VPC peering (preferred window 01:00-04:00 UTC), private model mount for PHI, capacity for 5 rps steady, 10 rps spikes.

Marco (Infra): Need customer ASN + allowed CIDRs. We'll provision a 3-rep pool, prewarm plan: KV warmup + 5 synthetic sessions. ETA for HSM for dedicated ~6 weeks; KMS available now.

Devin (Solutions): I'll upload a 12-prompt smoke set and a small test harness to /shared/helixera. Quick curl for post-SSO smoke: curl -X POST https://dedicated.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -d '{"model":"redwood-7b-ded","input":"ping"}'

Evan (CS Ops): I'll open ticket HEL-301 "Helixera onboarding" and add checklist items (SSO, SCIM, peering, model mount, smoke tests, canary).

handoff-bot: Ticket HEL-301 created by Evan (CS Ops) - https://support.redwood.ai/HEL-301

Ritika (Support): Will prepare 30-day oncall plan and alerts: page on error-rate>1.5% or p95>350ms. Please confirm success metrics.

Priya (CS): Success metrics: go-live <=28d, p95 <300ms at steady 5 rps, smoke pass, SSO+SCIM functional, zero Sev1 in first 14 days. I'll schedule kickoff Thu 14:00 UTC and share agenda.

Nora (Sales): Procurement flagged a 8% conditional credit if SLA breach in first 60 days. Legal agreed to conditional clause. Track in risk register.

Marco (Infra): I'll run staging capacity test tomorrow and post numbers in HEL-301.

Priya (CS): Action items: Nora - confirm ASN and contact; Marco - peering + HSM/KMS note; Devin - smoke tests; Evan - ticket + runbook; Ritika - oncall/playbook. Owners update HEL-301.

Nora (Sales): Sending ASN now. Thanks team.

Priya (CS): Nice handoff. I'll follow up after kickoff with status and risk register.
